mistral-pricing.title: Mistral OCR pricing
mistral-pricing.note: OCR 4.1 standard USD 4/1,000 pages. The flattened pricing table places 0.40 under cached input, not batch; the old 0.40 batch claim is unverified. Official batch documentation specifies 50% off.

legacy-snapshot.title: OCR research snapshot 2026-09-30

datalab-pricing.title: Datalab hosted processor rate card
datalab-pricing.note: Convert fast/balanced $4 and accurate $10 per 1,000 pages; EU +25%; optional retention discount and add-ons. Current service rates do not pin a historical Chandra generation.

extend-pricing.title: Extend Pay As You Go pricing
extend-pricing.note: PAYG $0.0125/credit; Light Parse 0.5 credits/page, Performance Parse 2 credits/page. Scale uses a different credit rate and monthly plan.
extend-pricing.source_excerpt: Performance Parse is 2 credits per page and Light Parse is 0.5 credits per page

reducto-pricing.title: Reducto r-1 Parse pricing
reducto-pricing.note: Standard r-1 Parse $10/1,000 pages; batch Parse 20% discount. Optional OCR data return and prompted regions cost extra.

llamaparse-pricing.title: LlamaParse v2 tier pricing
llamaparse-pricing.note: USD 1.25/1,000 credits; v2 Fast 1, Cost-effective 3, Agentic 10, Agentic Plus 45 credits/page. Add-ons and billable-page definitions vary.

claude-token-pricing.title: Anthropic direct API token pricing
claude-token-pricing.note: Standard direct/global API prices per million tokens, separate from benchmark page-cost estimates; caching, batch, fast mode and regional pricing have distinct rates.

gemini-token-pricing.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview token pricing
gemini-token-pricing.note: Prices apply to gemini-3.1-pro-preview, not Gemini 3 Pro. Separate <=200k and >200k prompt bands; output includes thinking. Cache storage and grounding extra.

xiaomi-weights.title: Xiaomi-OCR-0 release and weights
xiaomi-weights.note: Model card news states September 30 release of technical report and weights; Apache-2.0 license. Self-hosted compute costs are not a vendor page rate.
xiaomi-weights.source_excerpt: 2026-09-30: Technical report published and model weights released.

poly-release.title: PolyOCR-Venus release contents
